3) Pricing sketch: committed units priced monthly with a 12-month minimum; burst priced at premium pay-as-you-go. I attached a one-page sizing & pricing outline (capacity_sizing_outline.pdf) with an example split and monthly estimate.

If procurement can provide an LC or LOI by May 10, we can target shipping baseline capacity in early July.

Next steps I propose:
- We finalize the LOI language (I can share a template)
- I’ll open an internal capacity ticket and tag infra for region allocation once LOI is received
- Align on a staggered handover schedule (pilot -> EU -> APAC)

Thanks — I'll loop infra once you approve.

Ben / team —

Quick readout from capacity planning:
- US (preferred): we can commit 32 A100-eq by July 1 from our us-west-2 reserved pool if order placed by May 12. Lead time includes kernel alignment and model profiling (2 weeks).
- EU (Ireland): 16 A100-eq feasible, lead time 6–9 weeks. Some slots in late-June but prefer early July handoff.
- APAC (Singapore): hardware scarcity likely — we can commit 8 smaller instances (e.g., 8xA10G or a mix) by early August in worst case. If Lumen needs July 1, propose a staged path: start APAC on burst (hosted) with a pinned quantized model variant to hit latency targets; then migrate to dedicated when nodes provisioned.

Alternatives to reduce GPU footprint: 4-bit quant + compilation optimizations gives ~1.6–2x effective throughput on some workloads — we should run their sample prompt set to validate. That would reduce baseline by ~30% in compute but adds a small quality delta (TBD).

I attached a short node mapping sheet (regional_node_plan_v2.xlsx) with recommended AZs and fallback lanes.

Karthik
